The requirement says the same and still agrees with what you asked for, so the record is not what is wrong.

The change breaks that rule. To stop the tidy commit failing on a new archive file that git ignores, the landing job now spells out the log folder path itself and works out which log files are of a kind kept local.

The problem it fixes is real, and the retry when git's index is locked isn't at issue. Only the place the filter lives is wrong. Nothing shows you asked for this: no prompt text was logged for the turn that probably made the change.

The fix is to move the filtering into the log module, so the landing job just commits the paths the log module hands back, without naming a log path. The commit should still succeed when a local kind has a new archive file.
